sources.snippet: 🦜 parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3: Multilingual Speech-to-Text Model | | Description: parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3 is a 600-million-parameter multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for high-throughput speech-to-text transcription. It extends the parakeet-tdt-.6b-v2 model by expanding language support from English to 25 European languages. The model automatically detects the language ...

sources.snippet: littoralai/parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3-mlx-8bit 8-bit MLX quantization of NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, re-hosted by Littoral AI for use as the balanced (default) local tier in Wavelet, a macOS on-device dictation app.

sources.title: Canary-1B-v2 & Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3: Efficient and High-Performance ...
sources.snippet: This work introduces Canary-1B-v2, a multilingual, multi-task model designed to deliver robust ASR and AST performance with high efficiency. In addition, we release Parakeet-TDT-.6B-v3, a smaller yet more accurate ASR model supporting the same 25 languages.

sources.title: Parakeet 0.6b TDT collection | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: Note: These models do not require separate language models, punctuation models, or ITN; they provide native punctuation, capitalization, and proper formatting directly from the acoustic model.
